summary: P01 V2.47.240 adds a lightweight personal Course Study Workspace. Course cards and Continue Learning now enter an internal P01 study workspace that keeps only Return, course identity, canonical source opening, discrete learning state/completion, and Owner browser-local notes. Third-party course content remains at the original canonical URL and is not copied or scraped. Without a real Lesson/Chapter Authority the product does not fabricate lesson directories, next-lesson flow or percentage progress. Commercial course-site features such as price, purchase, membership, ratings, Q&A and cart are intentionally omitted. Existing `books` canonical storage and `vf-course-state:v1:<id>` remain unchanged; notes use browser-local `vf-course-note:v1:<id>` convenience state only. No Schema/Migration, canonical data mutation, auth/session/security, updater mechanism, provider/server or Production write change. Production remains Owner-manual. Release retry also preserves the previously frozen contiguous Course card action source contract; behavior is unchanged.
